replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics has always been a passion of mine. I find it fascinating how numbers can explain the world around us. It's like a puzzle that never ends, and solving it brings me joy.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. I enjoy math challenges, but sometimes complex problems can be overwhelming. However, I take them as opportunities to learn and grow.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tool for math practice. It helped me understand concepts better with instant feedback. The experience was great, but it's no substitute for human teaching.
